description: Reference definition of the ETF research universe used in the finance analytics project

etfs.research_rationale: Broad developed- and emerging-market equity exposure providing a representative global equity allocation.

etfs.fund_name: Vanguard FTSE Developed World UCITS ETF
etfs.research_rationale: Alternative developed-market benchmark using the FTSE methodology for cross-index comparison.
Provides a second implementation of the MSCI World exposure for tracking-error and implementation analysis.

note: This is a truncated sample showing first 3 ETFs. The full universe contains 32 ETFs covering global equities, US equities, regional/emerging market equities, factor/smart beta equities, sector/industry equities, fixed income, commodities/precious metals, and REITS/alternatives.
